title: Stable Matrix Rust SDK 0.18.0 capability probes

tag_commit_verification.notes: Absolute temporary clone paths intentionally omitted.

direct_dependencies.name: matrix-sdk
feature_notes: This probe requests default-features=false and features=[].
resolved_enabled_features includes e2e-encryption solely via Cargo feature unification from matrix-sdk-ui 0.18.0.
sqlite and automatic-room-key-forwarding are not enabled.

direct_dependencies.name: matrix-sdk-ui
feature_notes: This probe requests default-features=false and features=[].
matrix-sdk-ui crate defaults are empty; resolved_enabled_features is empty.

candidate_selection.method: Reviewed Plan Section 7 areas and P0.1 desktop-sdk-usage categories; selected representative stable public API shapes present at the pinned commit that compile with the P0.3a feature resolution.
minimum_areas_covered: client construction/homeserver discovery and login/session restore
message send, state send, redaction, receipts/read markers, typing
server-side search (stable user/directory; message search deferred)
candidate_selection.evidence_status_policy: stable-api-probed or deferred-to-p0.3c only. Final Section 5 states such as confirmed-stable are not used: compile evidence alone does not prove runtime, live-server, or UI behavior.
uncovered_or_deferred_for_p0_3c_or_p0_3d: Server-side room message search high-level API (absent); typed Client::send residual path (P0.3c)
experimental-widgets / Element Call / MatrixRTC widget bridge (P0.3c)
sqlite store builders and encrypted store runtime (feature sqlite not enabled; P0.3c/P0.5)
SSO/OAuth full callback flow runtime (API exists; deeper OAuth surfaces may expand in P0.3c)
SAS verification request inbox runtime details (types accessible via encryption module; deeper verification APIs in P0.3c)
Live Synapse two-client tests and UI acceptance (P0.3d / later phases)
Polls, composer drafts, and product-specific custom event contracts mapping (parity, not API absence)
